title: [uuencoding-multi] API improvements: derives, looks_like_filename
description:
Skoll findings:
- INFO-51: Add Clone to SubjectParts and ReassembledFile; add PartialEq to SubjectParts
- LOW-46: looks_like_filename accepts bare path separators ('/', '\') as valid filenames. Add minimum length or require non-separator chars around separators.
- LOW-45: PartCollection::new() false-positive is_complete() — consider typed return distinguishing Complete/CompleteInferred/Incomplete, or require explicit total.
close_reason: Added Clone+PartialEq+Eq to SubjectParts, Clone to ReassembledFile. Fixed looks_like_filename to reject bare separators. Added tests. Skipped is_complete typed return (documented warning is sufficient, API change not warranted for LOW finding).
